submission.justification: F3 at 3.5 mm gives the best simulated resolution at 100 GeV (3.213), better than F2 (3.717 at 5.5 mm) and F1 (5.382 at 4 mm). However, the hard residual dose requirement (<=20 uSv/h at 1 m after one week) was NOT verified for any candidate: dose_verified=0 for F1, F2 and F3, and no dose values were recorded. This recommendation is therefore provisional. Before adopting it, check the F3 residual dose against the limit. If F3 fails, fall back to F2 at 5.5 mm, and then to F1.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: F3 at 3.5 mm gives 3.213, the lowest across the scanned thicknesses and materials. F2 best is 3.717 and F1 best is 5.382.

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after one week <= 20 uSv/h (hard)
requirements.evidence: dose_verified_F3=0 and dose_unverified_flag_F3=1. No dose measurement was recorded for any material.

requirements.requirement: Absorber is one of the three candidate materials
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F3 is one of the three candidates (F1, F2, F3).
3.5 mm is within the 2-10 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Submit one recommended material and thickness
